board.label: Job applications board

errors.invalidAmount: Enter a whole number, for example 3000.
errors.salaryOrder: “Salary from” must not be larger than “Salary to”.

vacancy.hint: Paste a vacancy link: Findy fills in the job title and the company.

dnd.instructions: Press Enter to open a card. To move it, press Space, use the arrow keys, then press Space again to drop it or Escape to cancel.

details.deleteMessage: “{{title}}” and all its notes will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

notes.title: Notes

reset.title: Reset the board?

reset.message_other: {{count}} applications will be deleted with their notes and stage history. Findy saves a backup copy of your data first.

columns.title: Columns
columns.lastVisible: At least one column stays visible
columns.hint: Hidden columns are not shown on the board, and no application can be moved into them. Their applications are kept.

errors.validation: This was not saved: check the data you entered.
errors.notFound: This item no longer exists. The board now shows the saved data.
errors.storage: Findy could not save this change. Your saved data did not change.
errors.network: Could not check for updates. Check the internet connection and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. The board now shows the saved data.
errors.crashText: The window could not show this screen. Your data is safe in the database.

mcp.title: AI assistant access
mcp.allow: Allow AI assistants to use my board
mcp.privacy: When this is on, an assistant you connect (Claude Desktop, Cowork, Claude Code) can read and change your applications when you ask it to. Findy itself sends nothing anywhere; your assistant sends what it reads to its AI provider.
mcp.desktopHint: Add this to claude_desktop_config.json (Settings → Developer → Edit Config), then restart Claude.
mcp.otherHint: Gemini CLI (~/.gemini/settings.json, "mcpServers"), Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Zed, Codex CLI and other apps that run local (stdio) MCP servers use this command.

analytics.chartHint: Point at a bar or use the arrow keys to see the values.

support.thanksText: Findy is free and open source, and it is made in spare time. If it helped you, you can support its development, or star it on GitHub so more people find it.
